sentences.en: He looked for it in the whole house.

sentences.ar: הוא לא מצא אותו בשום מקום.
sentences.en: He did not find it anywhere.
He went out to the street and asked people.
He announced in the market in a loud voice.
He said: whoever found a purse.
He said: will receive half from me.
A man came to him at once.
He said: I found it on the road.
Juha said: there were twenty there.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אז לקחת את החצי.
sentences.en: He said: so you took the half.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: וזה בדיוק הפרס שלך.
sentences.en: He said: and that is exactly your prize.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: תודה רבה לך, אדוני.
sentences.en: He said: thank you very much, sir.

sentences.ar: האיש עמד ולא ידע מה לומר.
sentences.en: The man stood and did not know what to say.
